canonical_decisions.decision: Retain the alert signal/device family across smoke alarm, personal alarm and equipment alarm history. The new compound selects detection equipment; emotion and call-to-arms history do not change the current whole-base depth.

canonical_decisions.name: exit
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse morph.exit/exit from exit interview as the related departure family. The selected noun is a physical way out; work departure is not a separate accidental homonym. The separate Growth growth.exit identity is preserved rather than silently merged.

canonical_decisions.name: automatic
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse morph.automatic/automatic from automatic lock for the independent/system-triggered operation adjective. Keep this current adjective whole after recording Greek automatos and -ic history; do not create a guessed matic part.

canonical_decisions.name: door
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse the physical closure/opening morph.door/door family across door equipment and doorway/doorstep. The equivalent Growth pair remains visible and unchanged; no cross-namespace migration occurs.

canonical_decisions.name: customer
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse the eleven existing whole morph.customer/customer buyer-family occurrences. The source-backed custom plus -er history is explicitly acknowledged, but this compound teaches the current buyer word as one constituent. All seven morph.custom graphs, including five decomposed customer graphs, remain exact and are not made interchangeable with the whole customer state. The previously accepted deverbal -er does not justify a denominal analysis automatically.

canonical_decisions.name: service
canonical_decisions.decision: Retain the thirty-three morph.service/service occurrences as related serving/work extensions: helpful or organized provision, physical utility supply, maintenance, availability for use, and legal serving of documents. Legal delivery is excluded from the selected customer-help meaning, not claimed to be an unrelated word solely because its domain differs. The separate service-tree history is absent from this inventory. Complete meanings, professional approval and procedures remain distinct.

canonical_decisions.name: desk
canonical_decisions.decision: Retain morph.desk/desk across physical work furniture, service counters and the metonymic organizational/contact function. The dictionary explicitly records the latter extensions. Customer service desk selects a help point, while the Customer Support expression can refer to the staff there. Growth growth.desk remains unchanged.

canonical_decisions.name: pick
canonical_decisions.decision: Retain morph.pick/pick for the related selecting/taking/gathering family; the existing seven Professional occurrences concern stock selection. The collection particle phrase pick up is directly attested. The pointed-tool noun is excluded; Growth growth.pick stays unchanged.

canonical_decisions.name: up
canonical_decisions.decision: Retain morph.up/up across directional, operation, continuation and completion extensions. Stand-up, uptime, follow-up, backup, upload, upgrade, dress-up and lookup are inspected as an established particle family rather than separate words chosen only for identical letters. Keep affix.up.prefix/up and growth.up/up unchanged. Pickup is collection, not a literal vertical-motion claim.

canonical_decisions.name: counter
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse reviewed morph.counter/counter at the accepted whole-current service-table depth, also present in the pending over-the-counter medicine graph as the selling-channel extension. The opposing/corresponding counter- prefix has its own pair and is excluded. Counting-person/instrument history is not imported as an English count plus -er graph.

canonical_decisions.name: return
canonical_decisions.decision: Retain all nineteen whole return occurrences as related return/back-transfer extensions. Physical goods, journeys and restored activity involve coming or giving back; computational return passes a value/control back; financial return is yield received back; a tax return is a submitted report. These attested extensions do not make their completed senses interchangeable. Teach the existing whole current base here while acknowledging French re/turn history.

canonical_decisions.name: queue
canonical_decisions.decision: Retain morph.queue/queue across a waiting line and requests/items waiting for processing. Call and print queues are related ordered-waiting extensions; the barrier selects people waiting. Growth growth.queue and the historical hair/tail sense are not silently folded into a new namespace.

canonical_decisions.name: barrier
canonical_decisions.decision: Retain morph.barrier/barrier across physical passage/vapor restriction and related language, accessibility and information obstacles or separation. The target is a movable line guide. French/Latin derivational history does not supply a current comparative -ier graph.

canonical_decisions.name: gate
canonical_decisions.decision: No exact gate base or gate-token canonical identifier exists in either loaded corpus. Introduce one explicit passage/access pair, english.base.gate.passage/gate. A gate can be an opening and need not have hinges. Whole gateway is separately inventoried; no whole gateway state is a gate part.

canonical_decisions.name: escalator
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse growth.escalator/escalator from the existing pending Professional graph and reviewed age08 graph, retaining whole current moving-stairway depth after examining uncertain trademark/blend history. Growth review is not inherited by this draft.

canonical_decisions.name: elevate
canonical_decisions.decision: No exact elevate base or elevate-token canonical identifier exists in either loaded corpus. Introduce english.base.elevate.raise/elevate for the current raising verb. The current elevator relationship is taught explicitly; its Latin origin is not misreported as an English suffixation event.

canonical_decisions.name: or
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse the exact accepted Professional agent/instrument affix.or.suffix/-or pair from conveyor belt and refrigerator. The retained affix.or.suffix/or and english.affix.or.agent/-or pairs are not migrated or treated as automatically unrelated linguistically.

canonical_decisions.name: enter
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse the reviewed Growth current going-in verb growth.enter/enter. There is no existing Professional enter part. The source surface is enter, while the authored entrance join specifies enter-to-entr stem spelling. The anatomical enter- combining form is not used.

canonical_decisions.name: ance
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse affix.ance.suffix/-ance from attendance and clearance as the current noun-forming suffix. The legacy affix.ance.suffix/ance form remains separate. canonical_decisions.name: s
canonical_decisions.decision: Reuse english.affix.s.plural/-s from twenty-two reviewed Growth graphs. Returns is a plural merchandise noun modifier. findings.finding: The building transport compartment is distinguished from grain handling, aircraft controls and anatomical instruments. The source records a Latin elevare plus -tor history. A modern elevate/-or analysis would require an explicit contemporary teaching-depth decision, exact authored spelling and current family inspection; neither a syllable split nor the origin alone approves it.

The moving stairway is distinct from figurative and contractual uses. The former trademark is described as perhaps blending escalade and elevator. The evidence does not establish a historically ordinary English escalate plus -or formation; retain the uncertainty when assessing the existing whole-base graph.

The entering-place noun has initial stress and is distinguished from the enchantment verb with final stress. The noun history points through Middle French to enter and -ance, while the verb is en- plus trance. Any selected noun graph must preserve that meaning and its authored surface change; the verb split is not transferable.

The way-out noun and leaving action are recorded with a Latin departure/go-out history. This supports examining a whole current exit base; the letters ex and it are not established as current English components by this entry.

The device adjective describes independent activation or operation. Its Greek automatos history and -ic relation do not establish a current English matic root. A whole current adjective or a carefully sourced deeper analysis must be chosen explicitly rather than inferred from an auto substring.

The noun includes returned merchandise, with returns explicitly used for goods brought back by a consumer. Financial yield, official reports and other senses are separately listed. The retail counter modifier selects merchandise returns, not an automatic equivalence among all current return identities.

The noun is traced to the verb phrase pick up. Collection or taking aboard is distinguished from a truck and several other readings. This supports examining pick plus up with the exact closed pickup spelling before joining counter, subject to sense and canonical-family review.

The selected customer buys goods or services. The source records custom plus -er and an older customs-collector comparison. Current customer-family depth requires a deliberate decision; the visible ending alone does not make it the previously accepted deverbal instrument suffix.

Warning signals and their devices are distinguished from fear. The borrowed history comes from an Italian call-to-arms phrase. That history does not support current English al plus arm tiles for the alert-device compound.

The physical passage obstruction is distinguished from abstract impediments. The French and Latin suffix history is explicit; it does not establish current bar plus comparative -ier. A current whole-base decision must acknowledge rather than erase that history.

The waiting line and computing sequence are separately described, alongside the historical hair/tail usage. The borrowed current queue remains a candidate whole base, with no silent-letter segmentation justified by the source.

Existing part-family uses still require inspection before reuse.

findings.finding: The writing-furniture reading is distinguished from a counter where a service or specific job is provided. The medieval borrowing supports treating desk as a whole current base; its history does not authorize disk as an interchangeable tile.
